title: THE POMEGRANATE HOUR, 3 AM · The host
venue: the motel · the lobby TV at 3 AM · recaps never run · Box 13
logline: The lobby TV at 3 AM on a channel the motel doesn't get: a woman at a table with a cassette deck, talking to the camera in a room with brass rails, and a title the strip draws as a fruit cut open. Wood draws the recap on the pad. The hum line under the panels. The host says a name the strip doesn't hear.
